description: Road Structures (PWS) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The location of infrastructure associated with roads such as bollards, bus stops, cattle grids, culverts, fords, drains, gates, boom gates, safety barriers, carparks and vehicle bridges as depicted in the PWS Asset Management System (AMS). Infrastructure is on reserved and crown land. View Dataset (permission required): AMS Data Structure:. Coverage: Australia. The portal shows 2026-01-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
